stories.title: How tech became the villain of the US midterms
stories.summary: Big technology has become a target in the U.S. midterm elections as voters react against data centres, artificial intelligence and the billionaires developing them. The Guardian describes campaign advertising that depicts data centres polluting an idyllic stream, reflecting wider public concern about the industry’s effects.

stories.summary: The Guardian’s review describes the iPhone 18 Pro Max as Apple’s largest, heaviest and longest-lasting flagship phone, with a price to match. It combines a giant screen, fast chip and high-end cameras with Apple’s biggest Pro iPhone battery upgrade, new Siri AI and a variable-aperture camera, delivering a claimed two days of use.
